summary: Frontend-only targeted testing of the 3 fixes: (1) address wording 'Alijah Kotla', (2) floating cart button visible on /wholesale, (3) wholesale bulk-quantity picker dialog with min-10 validation. All three feature groups pass end-to-end. Also verified retail flow regression and unified WhatsApp checkout.
critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing (unrelated to this iteration) React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' inside the <select> on WholesaleProductsPage.jsx. This is caused by the visual-editor injector wrapping option text in a <span>. Not user-visible and not introduced by this iteration, but worth flagging.
seed_data_creation: None. LocalStorage cleared before each flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three requested fixes verified: Alijah Kotla present everywhere (home hero, About, Navbar top notice, Contact map card, Checkout delivery-info-box, WhatsApp order message) and no 'Aliabad' remains in /app/frontend/src.
